newsitem.title: GERMANY: BA seeks bids of over one billion dollars.
newsitem.headline: BA seeks bids of over one billion dollars.

text.p: British Airways said on Tuesday it had called on five of the world's largest aircraft manufacturers to bid for the delivery of up to 60 new regional jets, a contract worth over one billion dollars.
Airbus, Avro, Boeing, Fokker and McDonnell Douglas were the five competitors tendering for the contract and BA said it was placing special emphasis on sound levels in the aircraft.
The aircraft will run on BA's regional routes and those of its partners, such as British Airways Regional and Deutsche BA, either in exchange for old machines or as added capacity.
